variables.name: POSTGRES_USER
variables.description: PostgreSQL superuser username. Change to harden the default account.

variables.name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
variables.description: Master database password — auto-generated at deploy time. Referenced by all Supabase services (auth, rest, realtime, storage) via ${{postgres.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}.

variables.name: POSTGRES_DB
variables.description: Name of the default database created on first boot. All Supabase schemas (auth, storage, _realtime, public) are created inside this database.

variables.name: POSTGRES_PORT
variables.description: Port PostgreSQL listens on inside the container. Must stay 5432 — all other services reference this port via private networking.

variables.name: PGDATA
variables.description: PostgreSQL data directory, placed under the Railway persistent volume mount (/var/lib/postgresql/data). Changing this after first boot will orphan existing data.

variables.name: DATABASE_URL
variables.description: Self-referencing connection string. Consumed by the postgres service itself and referenced by dependent services as ${{postgres.DATABASE_URL}}.
